title: CLCON/222/2016 of Mustak Husain Vs D.p.singh

paras.text:
CLCON No.222 of 2016
U. C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. Dinesh Chauhan, Advocate present
for the petitioner.
By way of present Contempt Petition, the
petitioner seeks to punish the respondent-contemnor for willful disobedience of Order
dated 26.04.2016 passed by this Court in Writ
Petition No.1085 of 2015 (M/S).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner
and perused the aforesaid order, which is sought
to be enforced by the petitioner.
 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits
that the respondent has not complied with the
aforesaid order.
Instead of issuing notices on contempt
petition to the respondent, the order dated
26.04.2016 passed by this Court is being
reiterated to enable the petitioner to get the
desired relief.
 Contempt petition is disposed of with the
directions to the respondent to ensure
compliance of the aforesaid order. In order to
remind the respondent, the petitioner shall move
a fresh representation alongwith a copy of this
order, as also the aforesaid order. The
respondent is directed to comply with the
aforesaid order no sooner a certified copy of this
order is placed before him.
This Court has not issued notices on
contempt petition to the respondent, inasmuch
as, one of the objects of the contempt
jurisdiction is to ensure compliance of the order
passed by this Court. Instead, the Court has
reiterated the earlier order with the hope that
respondent authority (ies) shall comply / execute
the same.
 (U. C. Dhyani, J.)
Dated 28.06.2016
Rawat
